name: prompt-bar
title: Prompt Bar
summary: The composer of an agent: a growing text field with attachments, a model picker and send.
description: The composer of an agent surface: a growing textarea with an attach menu, a model picker, dictation and send. Typing @ opens a list of sources and / a list of commands; the textarea keeps focus and the list follows the combobox pattern. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line, and while the agent works the send button becomes a stop button. The model picker is our quiet select and the attach menu is our menu, so their behaviour comes from Zag in every target; the suggestion lists share one framework-neutral controller (prompt-suggest.ts).

The bordered surface; anchors the suggestion lists
glimm shader canvas behind the content, invisible at rest; data-sweeping while the send sweep plays
role=list of attached files
The real Tag (tone neutral; shape pill in a pill bar, rounded otherwise) as role=listitem, marked data-prompt-bar="attachment"; the file glyph is its icon; a path-like name is middle-truncated

The Tag's remove button (the real Button, ghost xs square, following the pill shape) with its tooltip Remove <name>; marked data-prompt-bar="attachment-remove" through removeProps (an attribute object passed to Tag)
Grid of the input and the controls
The real Menu, marked data-prompt-bar="attach", with the attach trigger
The real Button (ghost sm square muted, rounded unless the bar is a pill), marked data-prompt-bar="attach-trigger"; aria-label Add attachments and sources
role=combobox, aria-autocomplete=list, aria-expanded, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant while a list is open; grows to a maximum, then scrolls
The real Select, sm and ghost, marked data-prompt-bar="model" on its root

A <button> with the button recipe classes (ghost sm square muted, rounded unless the bar is a pill: its level bars must be its own flex item), data-slot="button", marked data-prompt-bar="dictate"; aria-pressed while dictating, when it keeps an accent tint; aria-label Start/Stop dictation and our tooltip
Level bars shown while dictating, in place of the microphone
The real Button (primary sm square, rounded unless the bar is a pill), marked data-prompt-bar="send"; aria-label Send, or Stop generating while busy, and our tooltip
Fixed over the composer, rendered in a portal; one per list. Carries data-scope="prompt-bar" data-part="positioner", so it stacks like every popup (base.css). Exposes --available-height
The popup: the shared popup surface (`lib/popup.ts`). data-kind=source|command; data-state=open|closed; hidden while closed. Opened by typing, so it shows at once

shape.description: Radius only. rounded: card radius. pill: fully round while it is one line, 24px once it holds attachments or more lines.

models.description: Model picker options (our select, sm and ghost).

sources.description: Typing @ lists them (matched anywhere in the label); accepting inserts @Label. Also listed in the attach menu.

commands.description: Typing / lists them (matched from the start); accepting inserts /value.

attachments.description: Attached files, shown as removable chips. Strings are accepted as names.

busy.description: The agent is working: the send button becomes a stop button and Enter does not send.

events.submit: ({ value, model, attachments }) Enter or the send button; the bar then clears its text and attachments
events.attach: () 'Add photos & files' was chosen in the attach menu

keyboard: Typing @ or / after a space (or at the start) opens the matching list; the first option is active; focus stays in the textarea
ArrowDown / ArrowUp move the active option (wrapping); the textarea announces it through aria-activedescendant
Enter or Tab accept the active option and insert @Label or /command; Escape closes the list until the text changes
With no list open: Enter sends, Shift+Enter inserts a newline; nothing sends while an IME composition is active or while busy
Model picker: our select (Enter / Space / ArrowDown open, arrows move, Enter selects, Escape closes)
Attach: our menu (Enter / Space / ArrowDown open, arrows move, Enter activates, Escape closes); choosing a source returns focus to the textarea
Each button is a tab stop: attach, model, dictation (aria-pressed), send / stop
notes: Icon-only buttons carry aria-label and our tooltip with the same text: Add attachments and sources, Start / Stop dictation, Send / Stop generating, Remove <file>.
The suggestion lists open from typing, so they open and close without animation; the highlight glides between options for pointer and arrow-key moves alike.
16px text on coarse pointers so iOS does not zoom the page; enterkeyhint=send.

motion: suggestion lists: the shared popup surface; opened by typing, so they show and hide at once (keyboard-instant). One highlight glides between options over duration.move, easing.out-strong, for pointer and arrow-key moves alike (the highlight is the one exception to keyboard-instant); a pressed option darkens to color.hover-2; "No matches" is the empty-state and fades in over duration.base
buttons: our button's press (scale to motion.press-scale over duration.press) and colour over duration.fast
composer: border colour and radius over duration.base (focus, pill growing past one line)

layout switch: when the text needs the full width (or no longer does) the controls and the input travel to their new place (translate) and the composer's height follows, together over duration.move, easing.out-strong (FLIP, flipRow in prompt-bar.logic.ts). Typing triggers it, so it is not keyboard-instant; typing back and forth across the threshold retargets from where things are. Never on first paint; instant under reduced motion
attachments: a tag pops in (fndn-pop-in, duration.popup) when it arrives
send: one glimm sweep across the composer per send, over duration.sweep (1000ms) at an even ease-in-out pace, then a fade-out at duration.slow; skipped under reduced motion and when WebGL is missing
dictation bars: loop while dictating; static under reduced motion
